mapper.sql: a.name as app_name, a.code as app_code, s.hostname as server_name, s.env as server_env
from deploy d left join app a on d.app_id = a.id and a.deleted = 0 left join server s on d.server_id = s.id and s.deleted = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from deploy where app_id = #{appId} and deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into deploy
deploy_no, app_id, server_id, env_code, version, deploy_type, execute_mode, status, applicant, approver, apply_time, approve_time, finish_time, reason, remark,
#{deployNo}, #{appId}, #{serverId}, #{envCode}, #{version}, #{deployType}, #{executeMode}, #{status}, #{applicant}, #{approver}, #{applyTime}, #{approveTime}, #{finishTime}, #{reason}, #{remark},
mapper.update:
update deploy
deploy_no = #{deployNo},
app_id = #{appId},
server_id = #{serverId},
env_code = #{envCode},
version = #{version},
deploy_type = #{deployType},
execute_mode = #{executeMode},
status = #{status},
applicant = #{applicant},
approver = #{approver},
apply_time = #{applyTime},
approve_time = #{approveTime},
finish_time = #{finishTime},
reason = #{reason},
remark = #{remark},
rollback_version = #{rollbackVersion},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select distinct released_version from ( select case when deploy_type = 'ROLLBACK' and rollback_version is not null and rollback_version != '' then rollback_version else version end as released_version from deploy where deleted = 0 and app_id = #{appId} and env_code = #{envCode} and status = 'SUCCESS' ) released where released_version is not null and released_version != '' order by released_version

select id, deploy_no, app_id, server_id, version, status, finish_time from deploy where deleted = 0 and server_id = #{serverId} and ( status = 'DEPLOYING' or (status = 'SUCCESS' and finish_time is not null and finish_time >= #{since}) )
